logger.doc:name: Log S3 Connectivity Error
logger.message: S3 Connectivity Error - Unable to connect to AWS S3: #[error.description]

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { 'errorType': 'S3_CONNECTIVITY', 'errorMessage': error.description, 'timestamp': now(), 'environment': p('env'), 'recommendation': 'Check AWS credentials, network connectivity, and S3 bucket accessibility' }]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Error Details

logger.doc:name: Log S3 Access Denied
logger.message: S3 Access Denied - Check IAM permissions: #[error.description]

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { 'errorType': 'S3_ACCESS_DENIED', 'errorMessage': error.description, 'timestamp': now(), 'environment': p('env'), 'recommendation': 'Verify IAM user/role has s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, s3:DeleteObject, s3:ListBucket permissions' }]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Error Details

logger.doc:name: Log S3 No Such Key
logger.message: S3 file not found - Key may have been deleted: #[error.description]

logger.doc:name: Log SFTP Connectivity Error
logger.message: SFTP Connectivity Error - Unable to connect to SFTP server: #[error.description]

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { 'errorType': 'SFTP_CONNECTIVITY', 'errorMessage': error.description, 'timestamp': now(), 'environment': p('env'), 'sftpHost': p('sftp.host'), 'sftpPort': p('sftp.port'), 'recommendation': 'Check SFTP server availability, network connectivity, and firewall rules' }]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Error Details

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { 'errorType': 'SFTP_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED', 'errorMessage': error.description, 'timestamp': now(), 'environment': p('env'), 'sftpHost': p('sftp.host'), 'sftpUsername': p('sftp.username'), 'recommendation': 'Verify SFTP username and password are correct' }]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Error Details

logger.doc:name: Log SFTP Path Error
logger.message: SFTP Path Error - Invalid or inaccessible path: #[error.description]

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { 'errorType': 'SFTP_PATH_ERROR', 'errorMessage': error.description, 'timestamp': now(), 'environment': p('env'), 'targetFolder': p('sftp.targetFolder'), 'recommendation': 'Verify SFTP target folder exists and user has write permissions' }]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Error Details

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { 'errorType': 'TRANSFORMATION_ERROR', 'errorMessage': error.description, 'timestamp': now(), 'environment': p('env'), 'recommendation': 'Check DataWeave transformation logic and input data format' }]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Error Details

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { 'errorType': 'EXPRESSION_ERROR', 'errorMessage': error.description, 'timestamp': now(), 'environment': p('env'), 'recommendation': 'Check DataWeave expressions and variable references' }]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Error Details

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { 'errorType': 'TIMEOUT', 'errorMessage': error.description, 'timestamp': now(), 'environment': p('env'), 'recommendation': 'Increase timeout values or check system performance' }]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Error Details

logger.doc:name: Log Retry Exhausted
logger.message: Retry Exhausted - Operation failed after multiple attempts: #[error.description]

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { 'errorType': 'RETRY_EXHAUSTED', 'errorMessage': error.description, 'timestamp': now(), 'environment': p('env'), 'recommendation': 'Manual intervention required - check system logs and connectivity' }]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Error Details

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { 'errorType': 'UNEXPECTED_ERROR', 'errorMessage': error.description, 'errorCause': error.cause.message default '', 'timestamp': now(), 'environment': p('env'), 'recommendation': 'Check application logs for detailed error information' }]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Error Details
